card.title: DINGO
card.text: When this unit attacks the enemy HQ, your HQ gets +1 defense and you draw a card.
card.flavorText: The Dingo scout car was a light armoured vehicle built in Australia during WWII. Australia had entered the war with few armoured vehicles and could not rely on large deliveries from the United Kingdom, whose factories were focused on urgent needs in Europe. This forced Australian industry to design and build vehicles from local resources. Ford produced 245 Dingo Scout Cars in 1942. The Dingo was based on a commercial Ford 30 cwt chassis, shortened and fitted with a Marmon Herrington all-wheel drive kit. It used either an 85 or 95 hp Ford V8 engine and had an armoured body made from Australian bulletproof plates by Victorian Railways. The two-man crew consisted of a commander and driver. Protection was 30 mm at the front, and 10 mm on the sides and rear. Its armament was a .303 Bren light machine-gun, and it also carried a Wireless Set No. 19 radio. The Dingo could reach 90 km/h, but its weight limited off-road mobility.
